regime.label: Risk-On
regime.summary: Macro backdrop supports equities and cyclicals.

gauges.name: VIX (equity volatility)
gauges.read: Normal volatility regime.

gauges.name: Yield curve 10y-2y
gauges.read: Inverted curve. Has preceded every US recession since the 1970s (lead time 6-24 months).

gauges.name: Yield curve 10y-3m
gauges.read: Not inverted.

gauges.name: High-yield credit spread
gauges.read: Very tight spreads — investors are not being paid much for risk.

gauges.name: Sahm rule recession indicator
gauges.read: Labor market not signaling recession.

gauges.name: Recession probability (smoothed)
gauges.read: Model-based probability the US is currently in recession.

gauges.name: Unemployment rate
gauges.read: Falling 0.7pp over 12 months.

gauges.name: Initial jobless claims
gauges.read: +38% vs 6 months ago. A sustained 20%+ rise has preceded recessions.

gauges.name: Fed funds rate
gauges.read: Fed is hiking — headwind for long-duration and rate-sensitive assets.

gauges.name: 2y Treasury yield
gauges.read: -0.65pp over 6 months.

gauges.name: 10y Treasury yield
gauges.read: -1.21pp over 6 months.

gauges.name: 10y real yield (TIPS)
gauges.read: Rising real yields pressure growth stocks and gold; falling real yields help them.

gauges.name: CPI inflation (YoY)
gauges.read: Decelerating. Hot inflation favors energy, materials, TIPS, commodities; cooling favors bonds and growth.

gauges.name: Core PCE inflation (YoY)
gauges.read: The Fed's preferred inflation gauge (target 2%).

gauges.name: 10y inflation breakeven
gauges.read: Market-implied inflation expectation.

gauges.name: Consumer sentiment (UMich)
gauges.read: Consumer sentiment.

gauges.name: Financial conditions (Chicago Fed)
gauges.read: Positive = tighter than average (headwind); negative = loose (tailwind).

gauges.name: M2 money supply (YoY)
gauges.read: Liquidity growth; contraction is a headwind for risk assets.

gauges.name: Industrial production (YoY)
gauges.read: Manufacturing cycle; negative = contraction.

gauges.name: Housing permits
gauges.read: +6% YoY. A leading indicator for the economy and homebuilders.

gauges.name: Trade-weighted US dollar
gauges.read: -7.4% over 6 months. A falling dollar favors international/EM stocks, materials and gold.

gauges.name: WTI crude oil
gauges.read: +15% over 6 months.

gauges.name: Buffett indicator (market cap / GDP)
gauges.read: Higher than 4% of readings since 2010. High = broad US equities expensive; long-run returns tend to be lower.
